open_points.subject: M02 Slot / M12 Flow creation actions
open_points.text: M02: "purpose: plain words for the owner and the agent, fixed when the slot is created"; M12: "purpose of a flow is fixed when the flow is created"; State 0 actions: "the first contract of a new slot name creates the slot" and "the first version of a new flow name creates the flow" (no purpose input named).
open_points.question: When a new slot or flow is implicitly created by first version authoring, where does `purpose` come from, and is creation allowed without it?
options: Require `purpose` as an explicit argument on the first create-by-author action only
Allow missing `purpose` and store a fixed default (for example empty text)
Derive `purpose` from another field (for example the name)
open_points.default_guess: Require explicit `purpose` when the name is new; refuse creation if omitted.

open_points.subject: M10 ManifestOperation identity
open_points.text: M10 fields include "base_url ... required_headers, instance_class" from the installation-selected instance, while identity evidence says: "equal readings of the same record digest are the same. Continuity: none; a changed record is another reading."
open_points.question: Is ManifestOperation identity only the operation capability record digest, or does it also include selected-instance facts that can change without a digest change?
options: Identity is capability-only (service_id, operation_name, record_digest); instance fields are runtime context, not identity
Identity includes instance-derived fields too (base_url/required_headers/instance_class), so instance change yields a new ManifestOperation value
Split into two models: capability snapshot and selected-instance runtime binding
open_points.default_guess: Treat all declared ManifestOperation facts as identity-bearing; changing selected instance facts yields a different ManifestOperation reading.

open_points.subject: M24 EffectApproval preview for file inputs
open_points.text: M24: "preview: what the owner saw — operation, target service, the built request and the input values"; K-08 requires approval of "the exact operation, target and input."
open_points.question: For file inputs, what must the approval preview contain to count as the "exact input" shown to the owner?
options: Include full file bytes in the approval preview
Include only file facts (digest, size, media type) and rely on separate owner file-read action when needed
open_points.default_guess: Preview includes file facts (digest/size/media type); owner can separately read bytes before deciding.

open_points.subject: M26 EffectAttempt creation when owner refuses
open_points.text: M26 meaning: "record written before an effect is sent" with statuses `in_flight|applied|not_applied|not_sent|unknown`; M23 has `refused_by_owner` and State 0 says owner refusal ends run `refused`.
open_points.question: When the owner refuses before any send, is an EffectAttempt record created, and if so with which status?
options: No EffectAttempt is created on owner refusal
Create an EffectAttempt with existing status (for example `not_applied` or `not_sent`)
Extend EffectAttempt statuses with a refusal-specific status
open_points.default_guess: Create no EffectAttempt on refusal; record refusal in NodeExecution/run only.
